# Launch Checklist (gate G4) and Report Templates

## Launch checklist

The QA agent fills each line with pass / fail and evidence. A person signs G4 only when every line passes or has a written exception.

### Assets
- [ ] Every asset in the master brief has an asset ID and is uploaded.
- [ ] Every asset passed the brand score threshold (default 80 / 100).
- [ ] Every claim is on the approved claims list, or was approved at G3.
- [ ] Each market has its own language version, checked by a native editor.

### Compliance (per market)
- [ ] Compliance gate result is "pass" for each asset x channel x country.
- [ ] Email: unsubscribe link, sender identity, postal address (US), "<ADV>" (SG bulk email).
- [ ] SMS / WhatsApp: consent per contact, DNC check (SG), send window, registered sender ID (GCC), approved WhatsApp templates.
- [ ] Creators: disclosure label per market, UAE / Saudi licence on file, usage rights in contract.
- [ ] AI-generated content labelled where required (EU AI Act Art. 50, platform rules).
- [ ] Special ad categories set (housing, jobs, credit) where relevant in the US and Canada.

### Tracking
- [ ] UTM tags on every link follow the master brief convention.
- [ ] Conversion events fire in a test (pixel, CAPI, GA4, CRM).
- [ ] Holdout group set (budgets over 20,000 USD equivalent).
- [ ] Dashboard live with targets per market.

### Spend safety
- [ ] Daily caps set on every ad account.
- [ ] Total spend in platforms equals the G2 budget.
- [ ] Auto-pause rules live.
- [ ] Alert routing to the account lead is tested.

### People
- [ ] Escalation contact for each market for the flight.
- [ ] Social and community team know the launch time.
- [ ] Sales team has the B2B follow-up brief.

## Weekly report (report agent, reviewed before sending)

1. Headline: on track / at risk / off track, in 1 sentence.
2. Results versus target per market: spend, primary KPI, CPA or ROAS, pipeline (B2B).
3. Channel table: spend, results, cost per result, change versus last week.
4. What changed and why (3 bullets maximum, with data).
5. Actions taken by the optimizer agent (budget moves, pauses).
6. Decisions needed from the client (with a deadline).
7. Next week plan.

## Final report (gate G7)

1. Goal and result per market.
2. Incremental lift from the holdout, with confidence.
3. Channel and creative winners and losers.
4. Cost and time: brief-to-launch days, production cost, media cost.
5. Lessons (5 maximum), written as rules for the client brain. Example: "UK B2B: LinkedIn document ads beat video ads on cost per SQL by 30%."
6. Recommendation for the next campaign.
